fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) are a near-verbatim spread of the m.thewire.in page's NewsArticle JSON-LD block, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may appear. Latest-mode records (S2-sitemap) carry title/link/pubDate/image fields from The Wire's category-1 sitemap.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (the URL you requested, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld or S2-sitemap).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description/dek (article-mode only, from JSON-LD).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, present on the upstream JSON-LD NewsArticle node.

author.title: Author
author.description: Author object as emitted by upstream JSON-LD (raw passthrough -- a single Person/Organization dict on every sample seen, but may vary).

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image object (article mode) -- or the sitemap `image:loc` URL string (latest mode).

thumbnailUrl.title: Thumbnail URL
thumbnailUrl.description: Lead image URL, article mode only.

mainEntityOfPage.title: Main entity of page
mainEntityOfPage.description: The canonical desktop thewire.in URL -- note this differs from the `url` field, which is the m.thewire.in URL actually fetched.

url.title: URL (JSON-LD)
url.description: The m.thewire.in article URL as emitted by upstream JSON-LD (article mode). Not to be confused with `_input`, which is the URL you supplied.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated topic tags, as emitted upstream.

speakable.title: Speakable
speakable.description: Schema.org SpeakableSpecification block, as emitted upstream.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline, from the sitemap's image:title (latest-mode only).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL, from the sitemap's loc (latest-mode only).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
